title: Sponsored: Footlights Rochdale runs acting, singing and dance classes for ages 3 to 18
excerpt: Advertisement feature: Footlights Rochdale teaches acting, singing and dance to children aged three to 18 at Wardle Academy, with further classes in Milnrow and Sudden.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

Footlights Rochdale is a stage school for children and young people aged three to 18, based at Wardle Academy and run by its principal, Aaron Doherty Tubb.

Its Saturday sessions are held in the Watergrove Trust Building at Wardle Academy. Tinies classes for three- to four-year-olds run from 9.30am to 11am and for five- to six-year-olds from 11.20am to 12.50pm, while the Main School for ages seven to 18 runs from 9.45am to 1pm.

The school also runs a Singing Academy for ages five to 18 on Wednesdays from 5.15pm to 6.45pm at Butterworth Hall, New Street, Milnrow, and a Stage School on Fridays from 5.30pm to 8pm at Saint Aidan, Sudden, on Manchester Road.

Footlights says every child takes part in a full-scale show each summer, with a shorter Christmas presentation, and that Arts Award and LAMDA exams are available. It says all staff are DBS checked and a trained first aider is on site at each venue.

The school says children are welcome for a free trial at any time. Prices are not listed on its website.

Contact: Aaron on 07493 622494 or rochdale@footlightstheatre.co.uk.

title: Sponsored: SJF Granite & Quartz supplies kitchen worktops from its Littleborough showroom
excerpt: Advertisement feature: SJF Granite & Quartz is a family-owned supplier of granite and quartz surfaces with a showroom on Church Street, Littleborough.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

SJF Granite & Quartz Ltd is a family-owned business supplying granite and quartz surfaces for homes and businesses in Rochdale, Greater Manchester and surrounding areas.

Its showroom is at 47 Church Street, Littleborough, OL15 8AB.

The company says it has more than 35 years of experience. Its work covers granite and quartz for kitchens, bespoke residential projects, and commercial and shop fittings, and it also works in partnership with kitchen fitters and kitchen companies.

SJF says it supports customers from the first consultation through to installation.

Opening hours and prices are not listed on its website, so customers should ring before visiting.

Contact: 07311 133375.

title: Sponsored: Hi Pilates Club offers women-only reformer Pilates in Littleborough
excerpt: Advertisement feature: Hi Pilates Club is a sister-run, women-only reformer Pilates studio in Littleborough with classes of no more than seven people.
body:
This is a paid-for advertisement feature.

Hi Pilates Club is a women-only boutique reformer Pilates studio in Littleborough, established in 2025 and run by sisters.

Classes are limited to a maximum of seven people. The studio says every class is fully coached and suitable for beginners, and names Foundation Flow as its slowest-paced and most beginner-friendly session.

The club says its aim is to help members build strength, posture, core control and flexibility in a calm and supportive space.

It recommends comfortable, fitted clothing and grippy socks, and advises against loose or zipped clothing.

Classes are booked through the calendar on the studio's website, which also has details of memberships. The website does not list a phone number or prices on its front page.
